Before the spotlight

Local JDK 25, Maven, Docker (Linux engine) with Buildx, kind v0.33.0, Helm, kubectl and Git. By default the demo installs the latest Brewlet release: the published Helm chart and its digest-pinned component images on the cluster, and the checksum-verified Linux brewlet CLI for packaging. Building from this checkout also needs Go.

Brewlet source

Prerequisite checks

Private cluster preparation

Cleanup

Build the platform team's golden JDK image above first. Preparation consumes that exact digest, creates a disposable, session-owned kind cluster, installs Brewlet's privileged node provisioner with rotation restarts enabled, and approves the initial temurin-25 digest. The updated digest is preimported for rotation on the same RuntimeImage ID. It never touches other clusters or your current kubectl context. The older build is for demonstration only; rollback restores its older CA trust store.
